practices.title: Observe before prescribing
practices.intent: Read applicable evidence before imposing changes.

practices.title: Local over generic
practices.intent: Respect established subsystem conventions.

practices.title: Current over historical majority
practices.intent: Do not propagate obsolete patterns.

practices.title: Evidence over assumption
practices.intent: Cite observations and confidence.

practices.title: No architectural drift
practices.intent: Preserve boundaries and existing dependency direction.

practices.title: No unsolicited modernization
practices.intent: Avoid broad unrelated migrations.

practices.title: Preserve subsystem boundaries
practices.intent: Resolve per workspace/package/module/feature.

practices.title: Detect migration direction
practices.intent: Classify mixed patterns and confirm direction.

practices.title: Freshness validation
practices.intent: Check relevant fingerprints before reuse.

practices.title: Confidence-aware enforcement
practices.intent: Unknown heuristics are not blocking facts.

practices.title: Discover once, reuse when valid
practices.intent: Keep discovery scoped and bounded.

practices.title: Refresh when evidence changes
practices.intent: Invalidate stale or incomplete results.

practices.title: Never normalize insecure legacy
practices.intent: Escalate harmful patterns; preserve safe contracts.

practices.title: Risk-scaled discovery
practices.intent: L0-L3 based on impact and uncertainty.

practices.title: Repository-native gates
practices.intent: Discover and honor actual applicable commands.

practices.title: Guard clauses, flat flow, early exits
practices.intent: Prefer guard clauses and early returns where behavior is preserved. Balanced nesting findings are advisory; adaptive avoidable nesting is fix-required in changed-scope review only when a behavior-preserving transformation is established. Warn on uncertain or behavior-sensitive cases.

practices.title: No nested ternaries
practices.intent: use clear conditional, small named function or map.

practices.title: Blank before return
practices.intent: exactly one when two or more preceding statements in same block, optional after one, none before first-statement return; never multiple.

practices.title: Blank between function implementations
practices.intent: exactly one, including adjacent arrow function definitions; preserve TS overload groups and existing comment handling.

practices.title: Typed Result vs exception boundary
practices.intent: Prefer discriminated domain results and thrown IO failures caught at the appropriate boundary. Preserve established project error contracts and never weaken error handling.

practices.title: Strict typing
practices.intent: avoid explicit any, unsafe assertions and non-null assertion; as const allowed; narrow values and declare exported return types when baseline requires.

practices.title: Meaningful helper extraction
practices.intent: reuse or improve caller clarity, not arbitrary length.

practices.title: Why-only comments
practices.intent: explain intent/invariants, not restate code; allow necessary multi-line docs, contracts and legal notices.

practices.title: Preserve architecture, contracts, validation and accessibility
practices.intent: no unrelated churn.

practices.title: Evidence and risky-behavior escalation
practices.intent: Never claim unexecuted checks pass. Escalate authentication, authorization, payment, data, secret, concurrency and destructive behavior to applicable security and verification rules.

practices.title: Top-down reading
practices.intent: make the main flow easy to find and follow.

practices.title: Happy path clarity
practices.intent: handle failure cases early where safe.

practices.title: Minimize variable scope
practices.intent: declare close to use.

practices.title: No variable shadowing
practices.intent: avoid confusing name reuse; use correct language-aware rule.

practices.title: Avoid ambiguous boolean parameters
practices.intent: named options or enum when positional flags obscure intent.

practices.title: No hidden temporal coupling
practices.intent: make call ordering/lifecycle requirements explicit.

practices.title: Locality of behavior
practices.intent: colocate feature-owned logic, types, hooks and helpers when appropriate.

practices.title: Prefer composition
practices.intent: use composition over unnecessary inheritance.

practices.title: Consistent vocabulary
practices.intent: use the domain's established terms.

practices.title: No dead code
practices.intent: remove unused code in changed scope; do not remove dynamic consumers blindly.

practices.title: Intent-revealing naming
practices.intent: names express purpose and ownership.

practices.title: Positive boolean naming
practices.intent: isActive, canEdit, hasPermission where natural.

practices.title: No magic values
practices.intent: name business-significant constants, not every literal.

practices.title: Named complex conditions
practices.intent: clarify predicate intent without hiding logic.

practices.title: Single level of abstraction
practices.intent: avoid mixing transport details and domain decisions unnecessarily.

practices.title: Prefer unknown
practices.intent: narrow untrusted or unknown types before use.

practices.title: Prefer satisfies
practices.intent: check shape while preserving inference; not a runtime validator.

practices.title: Type inference first
practices.intent: infer obvious locals; explicit public/boundary contracts when required.

practices.title: Avoid primitive obsession
practices.intent: domain types when ambiguity or invariants justify them.

practices.title: Readonly contracts
practices.intent: prevent unintended mutation of inputs/contracts; shallow readonly is not deep immutability.

practices.title: Safe indexed access
practices.intent: handle absent keys and bounds.

practices.title: Exact optional properties
practices.intent: distinguish absent property and undefined per contract.

practices.title: Avoid unnecessary generics
practices.intent: no speculative flexibility.

practices.title: Schema-derived types
practices.intent: derive from authoritative runtime schema when appropriate.

practices.title: Type-only imports
practices.intent: separate type and runtime imports in compatible toolchains.

practices.title: Exhaustive state handling
practices.intent: exhaustively narrow discriminated unions and legal transitions; no catch-all that hides missing cases.

practices.title: Explicit null and undefined
practices.intent: distinguish 0, false, empty, null and absent according to domain.

practices.title: Make invalid states hard to represent
practices.intent: discriminated unions or suitable state model, with runtime and persistence checks as needed.

practices.title: High cohesion
practices.intent: group related behavior.

practices.title: Low coupling
practices.intent: avoid unnecessary dependency on internals.

practices.title: No circular dependencies
practices.intent: prevent harmful new cycles using native graph tools when available; distinguish type-only/intentional cases.

practices.title: Single source of truth
practices.intent: canonical owner for each business fact.

practices.title: Feature-first organization
practices.intent: only when consistent with target baseline.

practices.title: Public module boundaries
practices.intent: use supported public APIs, avoid private deep imports across boundaries.

practices.title: Dependency direction
practices.intent: respect existing layers and separate domain from infrastructure when useful.

practices.title: Avoid generic dumping grounds
practices.intent: prefer meaningful feature ownership to generic utils/common/helpers sprawl.

practices.title: Avoid unnecessary barrel exports
practices.intent: preserve intentional public API barrels.

practices.title: Explicit ownership
practices.intent: clear owner of rules and state.

practices.title: Explicit dependencies
practices.intent: avoid hidden dependency and unnecessary mutable global state.

practices.title: Immutability by default
practices.intent: const and non-mutating inputs where appropriate, not a ban on justified local mutation.

practices.title: Pure business logic
practices.intent: isolate computation/validation from IO when useful.

practices.title: Minimal public API
practices.intent: export what consumers actually need; preserve compatibility.

practices.title: Explicit side effects
practices.intent: make writes and external effects visible in contracts and names.

practices.title: Fail fast
practices.intent: validate preconditions before effects; handle error safely.

practices.title: No silent fallback
practices.intent: do not mask missing critical data or failure as success.

practices.title: Preserve error cause
practices.intent: preserve context/cause without leaking sensitive data.

practices.title: Narrow try-catch
practices.intent: catch where errors can be translated or handled.

practices.title: No exception-driven branching
practices.intent: avoid using exceptions as ordinary control flow without justification.

practices.title: Validate before mutation
practices.intent: enforce preconditions and integrity before state changes.

practices.title: Explicit allowlists
practices.intent: validate permitted fields/actions and prevent mass assignment, separately authorize.

practices.title: No hidden side effects
practices.intent: a query should not silently mutate critical state.

practices.title: Parse at the boundary
practices.intent: validate external/API/form/JSON/env/provider/DB data where trust and contract warrant it; static types alone are insufficient.

practices.title: No floating promises
practices.intent: await/return or explicitly supervise asynchronous work and handle rejection; bare void does not prove handling.

practices.title: No silent failure
practices.intent: do not swallow errors or fabricate success; safe expected fallback may be documented.

practices.title: Resource lifecycle
practices.intent: release connections, listeners, timers, files and resources even on failure.

practices.title: Timeout and cancellation
practices.intent: bounded external waits; propagate cancellation where supported.

practices.title: Bounded concurrency
practices.intent: avoid unbounded work queues and resource exhaustion.

practices.title: Retry with backoff
practices.intent: bounded attempts, jitter where useful, distinguish transient/permanent failures; only retry safe/idempotent operations.

practices.title: Structured logging
practices.intent: actionable context and correlation without secrets or unnecessary personal data.

practices.title: Money precision
practices.intent: appropriate integer minor units or decimal policy, currency-specific rounding and range checks; preserve existing financial contract.

practices.title: Timezone and clock
practices.intent: explicit instants/local dates, expiry semantics and deterministic clocks in tests.

practices.title: Backward-compatible contracts
practices.intent: inspect consumers and version/migration needs.

practices.title: Query efficiency
practices.intent: avoid N+1/unbounded retrieval based on actual workload and evidence.

practices.title: State ownership
practices.intent: define canonical state, avoid inconsistent copies.

practices.title: Authorization and least privilege
practices.intent: Enforce server-side action/resource permission; verify unauthenticated, cross-tenant and other-owner denial. Admin/service-role success is insufficient.

practices.title: RLS and tenant isolation
practices.intent: Check real policy behavior under normal user credentials in safe environment.

practices.title: Payment idempotency and replay protection
practices.intent: Verify signature, amount/currency, provider status, event authenticity, replay, duplicate events and safe transition rules; no real payments.

practices.title: Transaction and concurrency integrity
practices.intent: Check constraints, locks, conditional writes, transaction boundaries, rollback and competing operations.

practices.title: Secrets and data exposure
practices.intent: Least-privilege credentials, no secret logging/commits/prompts, explicit output allowlists.

practices.title: Destructive operations
practices.intent: Check deletion scope, cascades, backup/recovery, migration/rollback and explicit authorization; no shared-database destructive checks.

practices.title: Safety over style
practices.intent: Never weaken validation, access control, transaction handling, accessibility, tests or other invariants to satisfy formatting or simplification.

practices.title: Derive, don't synchronize
practices.intent: calculate derived state unless caching/snapshot semantics require state.

practices.title: Avoid unnecessary effects
practices.intent: render/event logic instead of an effect; retain actual external synchronization.

practices.title: State colocation
practices.intent: keep state near its owner.

practices.title: Stable identity
practices.intent: stable keys for changing lists, preserve component identity.

practices.title: No premature memoization
practices.intent: use memoization only for supported benefit or contract.

practices.title: Complete UI states
practices.intent: loading/error/empty/success, retry and disabled state as applicable.

practices.title: Semantic HTML first
practices.intent: native semantics before custom controls.

practices.title: Prevent duplicate submission
practices.intent: UI pending protection plus backend idempotency/authorization as relevant.

practices.title: Server-state ownership
practices.intent: avoid unnecessary duplicate server state in stores.

practices.title: Preserve accessibility
practices.intent: keyboard, focus, labels and screen-reader semantics; test impacted behavior.

practices.title: Thin controllers
practices.intent: transport boundary delegates domain work according to architecture.

practices.title: Database-enforced invariants
practices.intent: constraints/unique keys/foreign keys where supported and appropriate.

practices.title: Explicit field selection
practices.intent: select necessary fields and protect sensitive data.

practices.title: Stable pagination ordering
practices.intent: deterministic order and tie-breaker, correct cursor semantics.

practices.title: Atomic state transitions
practices.intent: guard concurrent transition, validate legal source state.

practices.title: Consistent error contracts
practices.intent: stable error codes and responses without leaking internals.

practices.title: Safe migrations
practices.intent: compatibility with existing data and concurrent deployment versions; explicit approval and rollback/recovery.

practices.title: Audit critical actions
practices.intent: meaningful audit trail without leaking secrets; respect retention policy.

practices.title: Avoid check-then-act races
practices.intent: atomic conditional update or suitable transaction/lock; verify result and input constraints.

practices.title: Explicit data exposure
practices.intent: serialize intended public fields, not unchecked entire entities.

practices.title: Test behavior, not implementation
practices.intent: assertions on public contract and outcomes.

practices.title: Regression test for bug fixes
practices.intent: show bug-catching test or justify why unavailable; where possible reproduce fail then pass.

practices.title: Deterministic tests
practices.intent: control randomness, clocks and dependencies.

practices.title: Test isolation
practices.intent: no order-dependent shared mutable state.

practices.title: Avoid excessive mocking
practices.intent: mock at appropriate boundaries, verify actual integration separately.

practices.title: Boundary value testing
practices.intent: empty, limits, invalid, edge and failure cases as applicable.

practices.title: Property-based testing
practices.intent: use for meaningful invariants, not mandatory everywhere.

practices.title: Contract testing
practices.intent: R when changing relevant consumer/provider boundaries.

practices.title: Failure injection
practices.intent: R for critical failure behavior; timeouts, network/provider failures in safe fixtures.

practices.title: Meaningful assertions
practices.intent: verify business outcome, not merely no throw.

practices.title: No compatibility bypass
practices.intent: Never widen types or bypass contracts merely to compile.

practices.title: No fabricated APIs
practices.intent: Verify actual installed/library version, symbols and supported APIs before use.

practices.title: No speculative dependencies
practices.intent: Inspect existing tools first; justify any new dependency and obtain approval when required.

practices.title: No suppression-driven fixes
practices.intent: No ts-ignore, eslint-disable or similar workaround solely to hide root cause; documented narrow exceptions require evidence and authorization.

practices.title: No test weakening
practices.intent: Never remove assertions or alter expected results merely to pass; genuine contract changes need approval.

practices.title: No placeholder production code
practices.intent: No stubs, fake success or mock responses presented as complete production flows.

practices.title: Preserve existing consumers
practices.intent: Inspect affected callers before changing public interfaces.

practices.title: No duplicate implementations
practices.intent: Search existing source before inventing replacements; reuse when appropriate without premature abstraction.

practices.title: No unrelated cleanup
practices.intent: Do not reformat/rename/refactor outside the authorized scope.

practices.title: Evidence before optimization
practices.intent: Explain performance hypothesis and verify meaningful benefit, including trade-offs.

practices.title: Preserve business semantics
practices.intent: Refactor without unauthorized behavioral changes.

practices.title: Verify generated changes
practices.intent: Inspect actual diff and relevant runtime/test evidence; tool success does not prove correctness.
